snippet.title: Kazu the Cassowary | Official Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A little bird. A big rescue. Meet Kazu in this 3D platforming adventure from Kodybod Studios.

Watch actual Unity alpha gameplay across rainforest routes, river crossings, tree ledges and waterfall jumps. Alpha and beta builds are currently estimated for 2027; dates may change during development.

The Kickstarter campaign is being prepared around a focused Windows alpha milestone: one hub, five levels and one boss encounter. Follow this channel for development and campaign updates.

Development footage recorded from the November 5, 2026 alpha using automated controller inputs in a separate capture copy. Game-camera footage; screen-space HUD omitted. Existing original KazuTitle project score added in editing; no recorded game sound effects or voiceover. AI tools have assisted with project coding, soundtrack production and promotional artwork. Gameplay is actual game footage.

#KazuTheCassowary #IndieGame #3DPlatformer #GameDevelopment
